title: 4.7 editor crash exiting with full page heap debugging enabled on windows 11
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.stable [5b4e0cb0f]  and master branch as of 6/29/2026
- Not reproducible in 4.6.3.stable [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot 4.7.stable - Compatibility - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download 4.7 stable build from website
2. Enabled Full Page Heap debugging: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Debuggers\x64\gflags.exe" /p /enable Godot_v4.7-stable_win64.exe /full
3. Ran Godot_v4.7-stable_win64.exe
4. Closed it
Result: Crashes with above call stack
5. Don't forget to disable full page heap when you're done or you'll be wondering why godot is running so slow: "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\Debuggers\x64\gflags.exe" /p /disable Godot_v4.7-stable_win64.exe
